description: Display-only mapping of segments.<segment>.stenosis_pct to the % shown in the report (display_pct) and its category (display_category), for model v19. stenosis_pct, prob_significant and every flag are unchanged. One mapping for every displayed segment. A segment with occluded = true (P(occluded) above the display threshold, epicardial segments) is shown 100% (occluded) instead; the CTO flag alone no longer shows 100% in v19. The mappings of v15 and v13 are kept only to redraw stored results of those models.
rules: otherwise: linear interpolation through the knots, rounded down to an integer (the fitted category boundaries are exactly 23.5, 33.5 and 42.5)
occluded (P(occluded) > 0.50, epicardial segments): shown 100% (occluded), tagged CTO or acute/other; takes precedence over the mapping and the flag rule
cto flag alone: not shown as 100% in v19 (it is a lesion flag and the occlusion tag)
significant flag: never shown as normal; an estimate below zero_below_pct is shown at the first display knot (20%, mild)

categories.occluded: occluded flag (P(occluded) above its display threshold)

provenance.model: DeepCORO-JEPA v19 (epoch 2, the served weights; point release v19.2)
provenance.source: display_mapping.json and thresholds/display_mapping_fit.json of the v19 release dossier (also in the Hugging Face revision v19.2); script evaluation/fit_display_mapping.py, cross-checked by evaluation/fit_exact_v19.py
provenance.dataset_short: the MHI validation split of model v19 (78,999 segment readings of 17 segments; posterior LV branch excluded from the fit)
provenance.dataset: MHI validation split only, no test data: 78,999 segment readings of the served v19 weights (same rows as v16 and v15: all validation segments except LVP, including segments labelled 100%), with the angiography report stenosis. The model estimate was clipped to 0-100 as the container does.
provenance.method: cal1 refitted on v19 (as for v13 and v15). T0 10.5 and knots 23.5 / 33.5 / 42.5 on all validation rows; 5-fold cross-validation grouped by patient, 3 seeds: T0 10.5 to 11 and knots 23-23.5 / 32.5-34.5 / 42.5-45.5 across folds.
provenance.not_in_the_metrics: The occluded display (P(occluded) > 0.50) is applied after the mapping; the agreement figures above are those of the mapping and the flag rule only.
